ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Complete the statement: If all plants were to die, the organism that would be directly affected is _____.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a food web. In the lower left there is a plant box labeled “Plants”; near the plants there are arrows pointing to several organisms, among which an arrow can be seen pointing directly to the tadpoles labeled “Tadpoles.” Reasoning: The question asks which organism would be directly affected if all plants died. In the food web, arrows indicate a direct relationship from the food source to the consumer; because “Tadpoles” directly receives an arrow from “Plants,” it would be directly affected.
